_comment: ML model manifest. Use vms-models download to fetch. Never commit .onnx/.pt/.pth files.

models.name: scrfd_10g_bnkps
models.description: SCRFD-10G face detector with keypoints (9-output, pre-sigmoid). Letterbox 640x640 input.

models.name: adaface_ir101_webface12m
models.description: AdaFace IR101/WebFace12M face embedder. 512-dim L2-normalised. RGB (112,112) input.

models.name: transreid_body_msmt17
models.description: TransReID ViT-B/16+ICS body Re-ID. 768-dim L2-normalised. (1,3,384,128) input. Calibrated 2026-06-16.

models.name: sh17_ppe_yolov8l
models.description: YOLOv8l SH17 PPE detector. 17 classes (helmet=10, vest=16, gloves=9, mask=5). (1,3,640,640) input.

models.name: yolo26m_pose
models.description: YOLO v2.6m pose model for person detection + 17 COCO keypoints. Used by PerCameraTracker.

models.name: osnet_ain_x1_0_msmt17
models.description: OSNet AIN x1.0 body Re-ID trained on MSMT17. 512-dim. (N,3,256,128) input, dynamic batch. Export via scripts/export_osnet_onnx.py.
